gloss: to govern, to rule, to manage

definitions.explanation: To exercise authority over a country or region.
To maintain order or handle a situation.

notes:
{治|おさ}める is an ichidan verb meaning to govern or bring under control.

TRANSITIVITY:
- Type: {他動詞|たどうし} (transitive)
- Takes を particle: 〜を{治|おさ}める

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {国|くに}を{治|おさ}める: to govern a country
- {世|よ}を{治|おさ}める: to rule the world
- {乱|らん}を{治|おさ}める: to quell a disturbance

KANJI DISTINCTION (same reading):
- {治|おさ}める: to govern, rule, control
- {納|おさ}める: to pay, store, deliver
- {収|おさ}める: to obtain, achieve
- {修|おさ}める: to study, master

RELATED:
- {政治|せいじ}: politics
- {自治|じち}: self-government
- {統治|とうち}: rule, governance
